eyebrow: The one fact behind this whole discipline
code:
ServiceNow:                      Customer:
- sets the release cadence        - decides WHEN to upgrade
- sets release content             - owns the testing
- does not auto-upgrade you       - owns the go/no-go call
caption: Upgrading is the customer's responsibility, not ServiceNow's.

eyebrow: Systematic means an inventory, not a glance
code:
Pre-upgrade testing checklist:
[ ] scoped applications
[ ] Business Rules / Client Scripts / UI Policies
[ ] integrations
[ ] ATF suites
-> each validated against an already-upgraded sandbox
caption: Every item gets checked deliberately, before production is touched.

code:
High-risk / high-usage:              Low-risk / low-usage:
- heavy daily usage                   - rarely used form
- deprecated API dependency           - no platform coupling
-> thorough, hands-on, first          -> spot-check, lighter pass
caption: "If this breaks the day after upgrade, who notices, and how fast?"
